title: Arizona Solar Incentives 2026: A Guide for Homeowners
excerpt: Explore the latest solar incentives and tax credits available to Arizona homeowners in 2026
content:
Arizona Solar Incentives Overview

Arizona offers a range of solar incentives for homeowners, making it an attractive option for those looking to switch to renewable energy. In 2026, homeowners can take advantage of federal and state tax credits, as well as rebates and financing options.

Federal Tax Credits

The solar investment tax credit (ITC) remains in place for 2026, allowing homeowners to claim a 30% tax credit on their solar panel installation costs.

Arizona State Incentives

Arizona Public Service Company (APS) offers a net metering program, which allows homeowners to sell excess energy back to the grid and receive credits on their utility bills.

Conclusion

With the combination of federal and state incentives, Arizona homeowners can save thousands of dollars on their solar panel installation costs. Visit SolarAtlas to find solar data for your city and take the first step towards a more sustainable future.
